messages.content: Include exactly 5 numbers in the response. For a generative AI system, suppose a generated output is substantially similar to an item in the training dataset. Does this prove that the training dataset item was memorized?

message.content: No, substantial similarity alone does not prove memorization. A model trained on 1 million examples can learn general patterns, then independently produce text resembling a specific training sample. Common phrases recur across 2 or more documents in any corpus. Proving memorization requires rigorous tests, such as matching against 3 unique low-frequency items and comparing with 4 baseline models. In short, 5 independent checks are needed before concluding memorization.
